text_zh: ……我觉得有人在按我，但也许只是幻觉……
text_en: ...I think someone's pressing me, but maybe it's just...
...lead shavings stuck in my gaps again, so itchy...

text_zh: ……那个声音又来了，是机油滴落吗……
text_en: ...that sound again, is it oil dripping...

text_zh: ……我是活的吗？前任从没告诉我……
text_en: ...am I alive? the previous one never told me...

text_zh: ……那个人总是很小心，从不重击字键……
text_en: ...that person was always careful, never struck hard...

text_zh: ……工整的手感，好像还能记起那种恭敬……
text_en: ...neat touch, I think I still remember that reverence...

text_zh: ……按R犹豫的那个，手指总是发抖……
text_en: ...the one who hesitated on R, fingers always trembling...

text_zh: ……他好像在查什么，夜里偷偷按键……
text_en: ...seemed to be searching for something, typing secretly at night...

text_zh: ……喜欢画画的那个，指尖总有墨香……
text_en: ...the one who liked drawing, fingertips always smelled of ink...

text_zh: ……最后一天很兴奋，说要去十二层……
text_en: ...so excited on the last day, said going to Layer XII...
